description: This file defines the SendThingMessageResponse class, a generic Java class representing a response message from a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract response class, encapsulating message response details such as headers and status code, and includes methods for creating instances and deserializing from JSON.

classes.name: SendThingMessageResponse
classes.description: A generic class representing a response message from a Thing, containing metadata such as headers and status code, and capable of JSON serialization/deserialization.
